plan: A Void empress who attacks faster and faster and chains dashes in every direction.
aSurveiller: Her E (Royal Maelstrom). She stays in place and hits the weakest target while healing: back off or interrupt her.
contrer: Back off when she casts her E: she stays still and targets the most wounded.
Buy a Grievous Wounds item: her E heals her a lot.
Don't let her take the Rift Herald or Baron: her R becomes much stronger.
forces: Heals and reduces damage with her E.
faiblesses: Weak at the very start of the game.

sorts.P: Gains permanent attack speed by taking down enemies.
sorts.E: Flurry of hits in place; she heals.
sorts.R: True form: more health and range.

momentFort: Strong in the mid game, very dangerous in the late game.
